verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both share the same flaws. The legal disclaimer is set large on the left, almost as prominent as the subcopy, which breaks the hierarchy. A stray small orange rectangle sits between the can and the headline. The tiny can and logo are cramped, and the subcopy is very small at this banner height.
